retrieval_examples.query: How can users export filtered reports?

top_k.text: The reports page now supports CSV export for the currently applied filters. Exported files contain the filtered rows shown in the report.
The CSV export uses UTF-8 encoding and includes the column headers displayed by the report.
Users can configure which email notification categories they receive from Notification Preferences.

retrieval_examples.query: What pagination support was added to the activity API?

top_k.text: The activity API returns a next_page value when more records are available after the current page.
The activity API now accepts page and page_size parameters. The default page_size is 50 and the maximum page_size is 200.
Reports support filtering by a start date and end date. The selected date range is applied before results are displayed.

retrieval_examples.query: How can administrators configure session timeout?

top_k.text: Administrators can configure session timeout values from 15 to 120 minutes in the security settings.
Session timeout changes apply to new sessions after the administrator saves the security setting.
Users can configure which email notification categories they receive from Notification Preferences.

retrieval_examples.query: How does offline project viewing work?

top_k.text: Mobile users can download selected project content for offline viewing. Changes made offline are synchronized after the device reconnects.
Offline project content is read-only until the device reconnects and synchronization is completed.
Workspace administrators can duplicate an existing project from the project actions menu.

retrieval_examples.query: What changed in search phrase matching?

top_k.text: Search now supports exact phrase matching when a query is enclosed in quotation marks.
Keyboard shortcuts are available for opening search, saving edits, and moving between common navigation areas.
The reports page now supports CSV export for the currently applied filters. Exported files contain the filtered rows shown in the report.
